name: Mystery transformer A
arch:
A one-layer transformer with no LayerNorm and no biases. Vocabulary of 114 tokens; the input is a sequence of 3 tokens; the output is 113 logits read at the last position.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos                     W_E: 114 x 128, W_pos: 3 x 128
  attention: 4 heads of size 32, causal       W_Q, W_K, W_V: 4 x 128 x 32 (per head: d_model x d_head), W_O: 4 x 32 x 128
  x = x + sum_h softmax(q k^T / sqrt(32)) v W_O[h]
  x = x + relu(x @ W_in) @ W_out              W_in: 128 x 512, W_out: 512 x 128
  logits = x[last] @ W_U                      W_U: 128 x 113
context: Tokens 0..112 stand for the numbers 0..112; token 113 is '='. Every input has the form 'a b =', and output class c stands for the number c.

answer.detail: Trained on 40% of all pairs, test accuracy 1.0000. Embedding Fourier power is concentrated in frequencies [8, 23, 25, 11, 22] (top-5 share 0.94). Expected mechanism (Nanda et al. 2023): embed a, b as cos/sin(w_k a); attention+MLP form cos/sin(w_k(a+b)) by trig identities; unembedding scores c by sum_k cos(w_k(a+b-c)).

source: Trained in this repo (lab/targets/train_modadd.py), Nanda et al. 2023 setup with 40% of pairs.
